description: Fan listings on XP open to offers, filterable by event, performer and whole-listing amount -- 'what's open near me this weekend?'. Listings the caller muted are left out. Each listing's identifier is what get_open_listing and buy_listing_now take; buy_listing_now buys a listing outright at its asking price. Event inventory at listed prices is in get_ticket_listings. Requires sign-in and the read:bids scope.

days.description: Only include offers created within this many days.

limit.description: Max offers to return after fetch.

max_amount_usd.description: Maximum total for the whole listing in dollars (all its tickets together), not per ticket.

min_amount_usd.description: Minimum total for the whole listing in dollars (all its tickets together), not per ticket.

sort_by.description: Sort field: created_at, event_date, amount, state, updated_at.

name: list_open_listings
title: List Open Listings
